board.sample.text: These are sample boards. Play around, or delete them: everything stays in your browser.

board.renamed.text: Another board already had that name, so this one is now “{title}”.

board.saved.text: Saved a copy to this device.

board.savedAs.text: Saved a copy as “{title}”, because that name was taken.

share.long.text: Link copied, but it's long ({n} characters). Some chat apps cut long links; if it doesn't open, send the board file instead.

share.failed.text: Couldn't copy the link. Copy it from the box that opened instead.

action.needsText.text: Write what you'll do before adding the action.

confirm.deleteAction.text: “{text}” will be removed from “{board}”. Done actions stay in the Done list until you delete them.

confirm.deleteBoard.text: “{title}” and its {n} card{s} will be removed from this device. Download it first if you want a copy.

card.empty.text: Write something before adding a card.

card.deletedParent.text: Card deleted. The {n} card{s} grouped under it are now on their own.

card.noVotes.text: “{a}” has no votes to take back.

group.withChildren.text: Grouped “{a}” and its {n} card{s} under “{b}”. Groups are one level deep, so they all sit together now.

group.redirected.text: “{b}” is already in a group, so “{a}” joined that group, under “{p}”.

group.self.text: A card can't be grouped under itself.

group.intoOwnChild.text: “{a}” can't go under one of its own grouped cards. Take “{b}” out of the group first.

group.noTargets.text: There's no other card to group this one under yet.

link.self.text: A card can't be linked to itself.

link.sameGroup.text: “{a}” and “{b}” are in the same group, so they're already related.

link.noTargets.text: There's no other card to link this one to yet.

move.withChildren.text: Moved “{a}” and its {n} grouped card{s} to {column}.

move.leftGroup.text: Moved “{a}” to {column} and took it out of its group.
